title.narrative: UNICEF contributed to reenrolling 83,204 out-of-school children and adolescents through the School Active Search (SAS) initiative. UNICEF worked with public managers and trained 19,600 professionals from 3,592 municipalities and 21 states in the SAS methodology, strengthening intersectoral policies and a system for guaranteeing rights to protect children and adolescents, essential to secure the sustainable permanence in schools and avoid dropout. Regarding school connectivity, UNICEF supported the Ministries of Communications and Education with GIGA&39;s tools and information to expand the public school’s connectivity in remote areas.
